task.name: Set_up_bar
task.when: During Build after the public-area footprint is approved

step.action: Confirm the current bar drawing, hardware count, anchor plan, storage layout, and final-state photograph in 📦 Build_Book.
Mark the bar footprint and guest path from 📦 Camp_Map.
Assemble the bar in the printed sequence.
Install every listed fastener, brace, strap, and anchor.
Place the cooler, service storage, and trash-bin positions shown in the layout.
Have the Bar Lead compare the completed bar with the final-state photograph.

passWhen.criterion: The bar matches the current drawing and final-state photograph.
The bar is stable and every listed fastener, brace, strap, and anchor is installed.
The guest path and service area are clear.
The Bar Lead completed the final inspection.
